scope: Momentum organizational bottlenecks; source-backed summaries, no raw communications. Slack claims require current provider checks before action.

cards.next_action: Inspect exact two automation mappings, preserve campaign fields, and stage deduplication using stable source-event and CRM record identity. Verify actual current provider configuration before any mutation.
cards.acceptance: One canonical lead task with campaign, owner, next step and receipt after two source notifications; ambiguous matches held for review.

cards.summary: AskRocco August 19 thread contains 63 replies, repeatedly re-asks answered creative-brief questions, and eventually returns creative links. In September, it answers Mac's question directed to Melissa as if it were a question about tagging. Evidence supports excessive interaction and trigger/context defects, not a claim that it never generated assets.
cards.next_action: Define exact agent invocation, reuse answered fields from text or forms, ask only materially missing questions, and validate actual artifact output. Test stop propagation and ignore non-directed bot chatter.
cards.acceptance: No repeated question for a known field; artifact or exact tool blocker returned; human-to-human message does not trigger an unsolicited bot answer.
